modules.module_title: Conducting pre-operation checks and routine maintenance of the Dumper/Tipper

pcs.pc_description: follow the work related instructions given by the supervisor before the shift starts
check oil levels of engine, differential, hydraulic tank etc. and top up as required
check water level in the radiator and top up as required

confirm availability and functionality of safety features in the Dumper/Tipper like audiovisual alarm, reverse camera, mirrors, horn, seat belt, Roll-Over Protection Structure (ROPS) and Falling Object Protective Structure (FOPS)
check fan belt tension, electrolyte level, and batteries’ terminal tightness
clean the Dumper/Tipper and outer element of an air cleaner with compressed air
apply grease to all the required parts
drain accumulated water from the diesel tank
check correct air pressure in tires
check and take action as per the entries done by the previous operator in the Dumper/Tipper logbook
check for any spills/leakages in the engine, hydraulic systems, differential etc.
plug spill, leakage of oil and lubricants and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check functioning of fire extinguishers, automatically operated fire suppression system and devices including fire detection system in the Dumper/Tipper
clean air filter dust bowls
ensure the locking bar is in position to prevent the front and rear chassis moving and creating a crushing zone (articulated machines only)
keep footplates and steps clean and free from dirt and oil
check main brake and emergency brakes, engine cooling system, lifting jacks
check different types of levers provided in the Dumper/Tipper.
check and adjust driving position, rear and side mirrors, seat belts and confirm clear uninterrupted vision all around

modules.module_title: Recording and reporting the details of Dumper/Tipper's pre-operation inspection and maintenance

pcs.pc_description: maintain the operation and maintenance logbook to detail all activities conducted before starting the Dumper/Tipper
inform the supervisor of those problems which are not under one's purview

pcs.pc_description: use Dumper/Tipper in an optimum way as per the instruction manual
start the engine by using pushbutton and key switch together
select correct gear range by shifting the quadrant device
maintain a safe distance between the two Dumpers/Tippers while driving
follow all bye-laws while driving the Dumper/Tipper
identify and report any unsafe condition while driving the Dumper/Tipper such as trenches, potholes and cables etc.
use various signalling devices available in the Dumper/Tipper such as turn signal, parking indicator, air horn etc. as per requirement

park the Dumper/Tipper at an appropriate place
use parking brakes and stopper after parking the Dumper/Tipper
drive Dumper/Tipper within the required cycle time in all situations, to achieve production targets

pcs.pc_description: place the Dumper/Tipper at correct spotting location on the loading site
operate Dumper/Tipper while ensuring stipulated load and operating within speed limits, as specified by the manufacturer

modules.module_title: Discharging the ore/waste correctly by tipping operation

pcs.pc_description: follow the shovel operator's signal/instruction regarding unloading location as per the quality of loaded material
ensure that the Dumper/Tipper is on the level ground before discharging the load
execute unloading/discharging operation accurately and safely at the site
follow the code of practice for tipping at the Over Burden (OB) dump yard or stockyard framed by the manager

pcs.pc_description: track machine operating hours to assess the required service
park the Dumper/Tipper on a firm and level ground before attempting to carry out any maintenance activity

check complaint sheet, logbook and history sheet of the equipment and identify repair requirements
carry out diagnostic procedures as per the troubleshooting checklist prepared by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)
assess when the problem is beyond one's competence and report the problem to concerned person

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: comply with safety, health, and security- related regulations/guidelines at the opencast mine
follow the safety instructions given by the workman's inspector
follow adequate safety while working at haul roads, heights, overburden dumps, sump area, stockyard, near moving parts, etc.
take safety precautions while working on sites (sub-station, workshop etc.), with equipment, and conducting welding and cutting operations
follow appropriate Safe Operating Procedure (SOP) while dealing with explosives
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or an emergency situation, within limits of the role and responsibility
provide first aid to an injured person
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify the environmental impact of related opencast mining operations
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
ensure not to mix topsoil with waste in day to day tasks
ensure that HEMM is washed at the designated location
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the mineral conservation practices specified by the organization in accordance with MCDR-2017 (Mineral Conservation and Development Rules)
assist supervisor for reducing environmental impact caused due to related mining operations
